manifest.name: dsh-reasoning-effort
manifest.description: Per-model reasoning-effort editor with embedded slider for DeepSeek Harness custom providers.

readme.text:
[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort)
[](https://github.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/blob/master/LICENSE)

> A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) Web plugin that integrates per-model reasoning-effort **configuration** and **selection** into the Web UI — a settings page plus a slider embedded right in the model picker.

DSH Reasoning Effort integrates per-model reasoning-effort **configuration** and **selection** into the DeepSeek Harness Web UI:

1. **Settings page** — choose which reasoning levels each custom-provider model exposes (`off` / `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max`).
2. **Model selector slider** — pick the reasoning level for the current session, embedded directly in the composer's model picker.

Both read and write the same `llm-pi-ai` configuration, so the settings page defines *what's available* and the slider picks *what to use now*.

> **Scope note**: the seven levels are the `llm-pi-ai` custom-provider level set. The DeepSeek native adapter supports only `off` / `low` / `high` / `max` and rejects other values (`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`), so use this plugin's levels for custom (pi-ai) providers only. `low` on the native provider has been supported since dsh v0.1.1-rc.1.

- Adds **Settings → Reasoning effort** to the DSH Web UI.
- Lists models explicitly configured in `llm-pi-ai.providers.<provider>.models`.
- Lets you toggle the reasoning levels offered per model, with a live slider preview.
- Preserves the model's other fields and existing provider-specific wire values.
- Saves through DSH's settings service — no manual configuration-file editing.
- Embeds a reasoning-effort slider in the model picker: select a model, then drag to choose its level.
- The slider supports mouse drag, keyboard arrows, and scroll wheel.
The settings page intentionally does not show catalog-only providers. Add a model list to a custom provider first, then open this page to tune that model.

Run PowerShell as your normal user and execute:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1 | iex
```

To install into another Profile without starting Web UI:

```powershell
$script = "$env:TEMP\Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1"
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1 -OutFile $script
& $script -Profile work -NoStart
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh | bash
```

For another Profile:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh -o install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh
bash install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh --profile work --no-start
```

The scripts download the latest GitHub Release archive, verify the GitHub-provided SHA-256 digest when available, keep it under `DSH_HOME/plugin-archives/dsh-effort-tweak/` for future dependency resolution, install it with `dsh plugin`, and start the default `web` Profile unless `--no-start` or `-NoStart` is supplied.

```bash
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-reasoning-effort-0.2.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH Web after installing or updating the plugin so the new client bundle is loaded.

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm run link-profile
```

This symlinks the plugin into `~/.dsh/profiles/web` and runs `pnpm install` there. Restart `dsh web` afterwards.

Requirements: Node.js 22 or newer.

```bash
npm install      # install esbuild
npm run build    # bundle src/client.js → lib/client.js
```

The client source is plain JavaScript + JSX, bundled with esbuild. React is externalized and resolved at runtime by DSH's ModuleLoader. No TypeScript toolchain required.

The plugin edits this part of the `llm-pi-ai` namespace:

```yaml
providers:
  my-gateway:
    models:
      - id: my-reasoning-model

The selected model's `reasoningEfforts` map determines which effort levels the slider can offer. The plugin uses the existing value for a level when one is already present; a newly enabled level is initialized with its canonical name.

> 一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）Web 插件：把「推理力度配置」和「推理力度选择」一起集成进 Web UI——一个设置页 + 一个直接嵌在模型选择器里的滑块。

DSH Reasoning Effort 把「推理力度配置」和「推理力度选择」两件事一起集成进 DeepSeek Harness Web UI：

1. **设置页** — 给每个自定义提供商的模型选择暴露哪些推理档位（`关闭` / `极低` / `低` / `中` / `高` / `很高` / `最高`）。
2. **模型选择器滑块** — 直接在对话输入框的模型选择器里拖动滑块，为当前会话选择推理档位。

两者读写同一份 `llm-pi-ai` 配置：设置页定义"能用哪些档位"，滑块决定"当前用哪个档位"。

> **适用范围**：七个档位是 `llm-pi-ai` 自定义提供商的档位集。DeepSeek 原生 adapter 只支持 `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`，其余值会被拒绝（`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`），请只对本插件管理的自定义（pi-ai）提供商调整档位。原生 provider 的 `low` 档自 dsh v0.1.1-rc.1 起支持。

- 在 DSH Web UI 中增加「设置 → 推理力度」。
- 列出 `llm-pi-ai.providers.<提供商>.models` 中明确配置的模型。
- 逐个模型勾选可用的推理档位，附带实时滑块预览。
- 保留模型的其他字段和已有的提供商自定义传输值。
- 通过 DSH 设置服务保存，不需要手动修改配置文件。
- 在模型选择器中嵌入推理力度滑块：选模型 → 拖动选档位。
- 滑块支持鼠标拖拽、键盘方向键、滚轮操作。

页面不会显示只有内置模型目录、没有显式 `models` 列表的提供商。请先在 DSH 官方"模型"页面中为自定义提供商添加模型，再打开本插件页面调整推理力度。

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1 | iex
```

安装到其他 Profile 且不自动启动 Web UI：

```powershell
$script = "$env:TEMP\Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1"
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/Install-DshEffortTweak.ps1 -OutFile $script
& $script -Profile work -NoStart
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh | bash
```

安装到其他 Profile：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Triple3h/dsh-reasoning-effort/main/scripts/install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh -o install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh
bash install-dsh-effort-tweak.sh --profile work --no-start
```

脚本会下载最新 GitHub Release 压缩包；如果 GitHub 提供 SHA-256 摘要则会先校验，并将归档保留在 `DSH_HOME/plugin-archives/dsh-effort-tweak/` 以便后续解析依赖，然后通过 `dsh plugin` 安装。默认安装完成后启动 `web` Profile，使用 `--no-start` 或 `-NoStart` 可关闭自动启动。

```bash
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-reasoning-effort-0.2.0.tgz
```

安装或更新插件后请重启 DSH Web 以加载新的客户端 bundle。

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm run link-profile
```

这会把插件符号链接到 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 并执行 `pnpm install`。之后请重启 `dsh web`。

要求 Node.js 22 或更新版本。

```bash
npm install      # 安装 esbuild
npm run build    # 打包 src/client.js → lib/client.js
```

客户端源码是普通 JavaScript + JSX，用 esbuild 打包。React 外部化，由 DSH 的 ModuleLoader 在运行时解析。无需 TypeScript 工具链。

插件编辑的是 `llm-pi-ai` 命名空间中的模型字段：

```yaml
providers:
  my-gateway:
    models:
      - id: my-reasoning-model

模型的 `reasoningEfforts` 映射决定滑块能够提供哪些推理力度。已有档位会保留原来的传输值；新启用的档位会使用对应的标准名称初始化。
MIT，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
